title: Introduction to Machine Learning Workshop
description: A hands-on workshop covering the fundamentals of machine learning, including supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms. Perfect for beginners looking to start their ML journey.

title: AI Ethics and Responsible AI Seminar
description: Join leading experts as they discuss the ethical implications of AI systems, bias in algorithms, and frameworks for responsible AI development.

title: International Conference on Computer Vision 2026
description: The premier annual computer vision event covering the latest research in image recognition, object detection, and visual understanding. Three days of presentations, workshops, and networking.

title: Research Team Weekly Meeting
description: Weekly sync-up for all research team members to discuss ongoing projects, share progress updates, and coordinate upcoming activities.

title: Deep Learning for Natural Language Processing Workshop
description: Advanced workshop exploring transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, and state-of-the-art NLP models like GPT and BERT.

title: Quantum Computing: The Next Frontier
description: Explore the fundamentals of quantum computing, quantum algorithms, and their potential applications in solving complex computational problems.

title: Southeast Asian Robotics Conference 2026
description: Regional conference bringing together robotics researchers and engineers to showcase innovations in autonomous systems, human-robot interaction, and industrial automation.

title: Grant Proposal Review Meeting
description: Internal meeting to review and finalize grant proposals before submission deadline. All principal investigators required to attend.

title: Data Visualization and Analytics Workshop
description: Learn to create compelling data visualizations using Python libraries like Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly. Includes best practices for presenting research findings.

title: Cybersecurity in AI Systems Seminar
description: Examining security vulnerabilities in AI systems, adversarial attacks, and defense mechanisms to protect machine learning models from exploitation.
